name: io.github.DishantSinghDev2/captchano-mcp
title: CaptchaNo
description: Solve reCAPTCHA v2/v3/Enterprise, Turnstile, DataDome and image captchas from AI agents.

environmentVariables.name: CAPTCHANO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Your CaptchaNo API key (starts with cn-). Create one at https://captchano.com/dashboard

environmentVariables.name: CAPTCHANO_MAX_SPEND_USD
environmentVariables.description: Optional spend ceiling in USD for one server process; solves are refused once it is reached.

environmentVariables.name: CAPTCHANO_WAIT
environmentVariables.description: Optional seconds the API blocks per solve before polling takes over (1-120).
